summary: Parse Server before 8.6.119 and 9.x before 9.10.8 LiveQuery Missing Authorization
details: Parse Server before 8.6.119 and 9.x before 9.10.8 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows LiveQuery clients without the master key to subscribe to installation and internal classes. Attackers can receive installation IDs and device tokens of other devices when these classes are in liveQuery.classNames, then modify those installations to redirect push notifications.
